name: ONTOLOGY2 -- the dynamic rails between C0-C3: flow as primitive, freshness as its derivative
description: Andrew-direct charter 2026-07-23 (verbatim in PRD s.0): the ratified C0-C3 ladder models STRUCTURE; agents ask DYNAMIC questions (what moved, did it arrive, is it current). Add three additive rails BETWEEN the rungs -- D1 VALUE/GRAIN (C0-C1: what travels an edge, at what grain; seed = derives-from's ratified EdgeKind passthrough|rename|recompute_guarded), D2 PATH/FLOW (C1-C2: directed typed path + per-hop transform + cadence), D3 CONTRACT/OBLIGATION (C2-C3: what a motif promises vs does). Derived properties are DEFINED as derivations, never primitives: freshness = D2 path + D3 cadence + upstream vintages + calendar (Andrew: freshness is downstream of flow, not a separate aspect); provenance/canonical-origin = D1 grain + D2 walked backward (= MSBEFF R2 comp-dataflow, as a query over D2 rather than a bespoke tool); blast = D2 forward-walk at a declared grain. Closes the measured failure signature: MSBEFF's 253 coverage failures are LAYER MISMATCHES the estate could not name.
phase: Phase 0 COMPLETE 2026-07-23: chartered. ADDITIVE ONLY -- ratified C0-C3 vocabulary, 14 roles, 10 relations, variance + completeness axes untouched. Seeds identified in the existing ontology (EdgeKind on derives-from; C2 motifs as typed multi-hop paths; PSTMRT completeness + TRIGGER_LAYER as proto-D3 obligations). Payoff: every tool declares (rail, grain, plane, scope) so wrong-semantic-layer answers become machine-detectable; comp-which converts from similarity scoring to TYPE MATCHING with an honest empty (kills the argmax-as-confidence defect riding 12,380 July queries); ARCHTOOL's pattern inventory gets the vocabulary it needs to type a pattern at all. P3 acceptance is hard: freshness-as-derivation must get RF-2 (Cottonwood never evaluated), the T-1 Monday false-alarm class, and the marker-oracle stalled-sole-writer all right, and must FAIL LOUD where today's config-driven version silently passes. Sequencing: ONTOLOGY2 P1 precedes ARCHTOOL P2; both behind the MSBEFF R-series builds in flight at 0.8.0.
blocking: None (sequenced behind MSBEFF R-series; P1 co-authored with 0.8.0_AE~C)
